mapper.select: SELECT a.ast15_tr_code_window_id AS tr_code_window_id , a.ast15_company_id AS company_id , a.ast15_window_class_nm AS window_class_name , a.ast15_tr_cd AS tr_code , a.ast15_note AS note , ( SELECT f_menu_nm_allpath(sys06_menu_id) FROM sys06_menu LEFT OUTER JOIN sys03_company_menu ON sys06_menu_id = sys03_menu_id AND sys03_company_id = a.ast15_company_id WHERE sys06_class_nm LIKE a.ast15_window_class_nm LIMIT 1 ) AS menu_full_name , ( SELECT ast05_tr_nm FROM ast05_tr_code WHERE ast05_company_id = a.ast15_company_id AND ast05_tr_cd = a.ast15_tr_cd LIMIT 1 ) AS tr_name FROM ast15_tr_code_window a WHERE a.ast15_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.ast15_tr_cd IS NULL ORDER BY menu_full_name

SELECT a.ast15_tr_code_window_id AS tr_code_window_id , a.ast15_company_id AS company_id , a.ast15_window_class_nm AS window_class_name , a.ast15_tr_cd AS tr_code , a.ast15_note AS note , NULL::text AS menu_full_name , ( SELECT ast05_tr_nm FROM ast05_tr_code WHERE ast05_company_id = a.ast15_company_id AND ast05_tr_cd = a.ast15_tr_cd LIMIT 1 ) AS tr_name FROM ast15_tr_code_window a WHERE a.ast15_tr_cd IS NOT NULL AND a.ast15_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.ast15_window_class_nm LIKE #{className} ORDER BY a.ast15_tr_cd

SELECT ast05_tr_code_id AS tr_code_window_id , ast05_company_id AS company_id , NULL::text AS window_class_name , ast05_tr_cd AS tr_code , NULL::text AS menu_full_name , ast05_tr_nm AS tr_name , NULL::text AS note FROM ast05_tr_code WHERE ast05_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast05_tr_cd NOT IN ( SELECT COALESCE(ast15_tr_cd, '') FROM ast15_tr_code_window WHERE ast15_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast15_window_class_nm = #{className} ) ORDER BY ast05_tr_cd

SELECT a.ast15_tr_code_window_id AS tr_code_window_id , a.ast15_company_id AS company_id , a.ast15_window_class_nm AS window_class_name , a.ast15_tr_cd AS tr_code , a.ast15_note AS note , ( SELECT f_menu_nm_allpath(sys06_menu_id) FROM sys06_menu LEFT OUTER JOIN sys03_company_menu ON sys06_menu_id = sys03_menu_id AND sys03_company_id = a.ast15_company_id WHERE sys06_class_nm LIKE a.ast15_window_class_nm LIMIT 1 ) AS menu_full_name , ( SELECT ast05_tr_nm FROM ast05_tr_code WHERE ast05_company_id = a.ast15_company_id AND ast05_tr_cd = a.ast15_tr_cd LIMIT 1 ) AS tr_name FROM ast15_tr_code_window a WHERE a.ast15_tr_code_window_id = #{trCodeWindowId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ast15_tr_code_window (ast15_tr_code_window_id, ast15_company_id, ast15_window_class_nm, ast15_tr_cd, ast15_note) VALUES (#{trCodeWindowId}, #{companyId}, #{className}, #{trCode}, #{note})
